main_text.p: impudentiæ, sed quo cœpit pede pergit calumniari, & falsis opinionibus onerare Ecclesias nostras. Juxta illud tritum, calumniare audacter semper aliquid hæret. Nos autem Christum non ita didicimus, ut qui novimus ex Apostolo Jacobo, non ex eodem ore benedictionem Dei & maledictionem hominis procedere debere. Non oportet fratres mei hæc ita fieri, inquit cap. 3: 10.
Quocirca modeste calumnias & maledictiones Harscherianas abstergam præsenti libello, quas magno numero in parallelis secularibus, seculi quarti & quinti, disputatione secunda nobis affricat.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Patre" is printed as ὁμοούσιαν (homoousian), transcribed from the scan with some uncertainty in the accents. The last line "totam" is set to the right, after a parenthesis; the following line is partly obscured by show-through and is not transcribed.
